svg.aria-label: Harness seam and the dsh adapter
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Harness seam and the dsh adapter
svg.desc: The factory reaches an external coding harness only through the neutral `Harness` and `CommandRunner` traits; `DshHarness` is the first implementation, and the real runner is the only thing that spawns a process.
